business_problem: Radiometer wanted a responsible way to design, build, and deploy an internal AI system that could generate exact insights, support scientific advancement, and help employees across knowledge, sales, service, and recruiting work without compromising ethics, governance, or security.
solution_summary: Radiometer worked with KPMG in Denmark to design and deploy RADChat, a proprietary internal generative AI system hosted on Microsoft Azure. The implementation started with an AI roadmap, safe-usage guidelines, and a requirements backlog for a data-integrated LLM environment so the team could govern how enterprise knowledge and business content would be used. Microsoft Azure provided the cloud platform for the business-critical application, while RADChat exposed the model to employees through use cases spanning knowledge management and retrieval, customer sales and service operations, and recruitment and onboarding. KPMG's governance frameworks, controls, processes, and tools shaped the ethics, security, and operating model around the rollout so employees could experiment with the assistant, help evolve it, and use it as a trusted productivity tool rather than a disconnected proof of concept.

source_references.title: Unlocking the power of generative AI at Radiometer

evidence_quotes: Radiometer wanted to explore the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) as a means of generating exact insights and fueling scientific advancements.
Radiometer was looking to find a responsible approach to designing, building and deploying an internal AI system.

Creating a backlog of the requirements needed to deploy an internal, data-integrated LLM solution was a key part of Radiometer's collaboration with KPMG in Denmark, along with defining the organization's AI roadmap, and establishing safe usage guidelines.

RADChat, the proprietary LLM AI system co-developed by KPMG professionals and Radiometer, and powered by Microsoft Azure, has been deployed for use across a range of applications within the organization, including knowledge management and retrieval; customer sales, services and operations; and recruitment and onboarding.
The tool is already transforming the business by automating and executing language-based tasks with unprecedented speed and efficiency.
